records.title: Semi-Mamba-UNet: Pixel-level contrastive and cross-supervised visual Mamba-based UNet for semi-supervised medical image segmentation
records.reason: Semi-Mamba-UNet is a medical-image segmentation architecture/training method, outside LLM inference.

records.title: LiveEdit: Towards Real-Time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Editing
records.reason: LiveEdit addresses streaming video diffusion and maintains rolling/junction KV caches across prompt changes. The cache method is adjacent to streaming inference memory, but the model is video diffusion rather than an LLM.

records.title: When Tools Fail: Benchmarking Dynamic Replanning and Anomaly Recovery in LLM Agents
records.reason: ToolMaze is a benchmark for failure recovery and dynamic replanning in LLM agents; contribution is evaluation, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Terminal-World: Scaling Terminal-Agent Environments via Agent Skills
records.reason: Terminal-World constructs terminal-agent training environments and training data via skills. It is a benchmark/training pipeline, not inference-cost or serving improvement.

records.title: STEPS: Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
records.reason: STEPS is selective on-policy self-distillation training for reasoning and does not report inference-time optimization.
